export type Payment = { amount: number; voidedAt: string | null };

export function activeTotal(rows: Payment[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (row.voidedAt !== null) continue;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(row.amount)) throw new RangeError('Invalid amount');
    total += row.amount;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total)) throw new RangeError('Invalid total');
  }
  return total;
}
